blocks.text: Charles Luke Templonuevo, a Bachelor of Science in IT student at Notre Dame of Marbel University, developed KoroAR as his undergraduate thesis project, using augmented reality (AR) to make historical landmarks, notable personalities, and cultural artifacts easier to explore through smartphones. “As an IT student, I wanted to create something meaningful that would help people, especially the younger generation, learn about our history in a more interactive and engaging way,” Templonuevo, the youngest of three siblings, said.
